name: Otherworldly Possessions gains enlighten counters per distinct reserve cost
notes: Otherworldly Possessions' element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 5-reserve cost is paid. A Dungeon Guide (reserve cost 3) is seeded onto the field and a Fairy Whispers (reserve cost 1) into the graveyard so the enlighten count reflects more than one distinct reserve cost; the observed result (3 enlighten counters) also picks up the champion's own reserve cost and Otherworldly Possessions itself landing in the graveyard after it resolves. Only the base enlighten-counting effect is covered.

rulesClauses: For each different reserve cost among objects you control and cards in your graveyard, put an enlighten counter on your champion.
